title: Trigram index state diagram
description: The life of one TriIndex, the in-memory trigram index a session keeps per walk configuration (search paths, globs, hidden and no_ignore; not the pattern). The state is derived from its `queries` counter and `disabled` flag. Only searches whose result is computed move it: a search answered from the session's result cache never reaches find_hits. Outside this machine, State.put_index drops every other index when the session already holds 8 configurations; a later search on a dropped configuration starts again with a new TriIndex. Nothing is kept on disk.

states.description: Created by State.take_index for a configuration the session has no index for: no files, queries = 0.
One computed search has been counted (queries = 1); it was a plain full scan and nothing is indexed yet.
From the second computed search on: holds an entry per walked file (trigram postings, or marked always-scan or binary) with the stamp it was built from.
The posting entries exceeded the budget (MAX_ENTRIES, 30,000,000); the index was emptied and every later search on it is a full scan.

transitions.trigger: A computed search on this configuration
transitions.action: warm() counts it and returns false; scan_all reads and scans every walked file.

transitions.guard: Posting entries stay within MAX_ENTRIES after finish()
transitions.action: warm() returns true; begin() marks every file stale; each is read once, scanned and classified (Update::classify) in the same pass; files over 2 MiB or inside the 2-second racy window are marked always-scan, binary files are left out.

transitions.guard: Posting entries exceed MAX_ENTRIES after finish()
transitions.action: The index is reset with disabled = true and find_hits falls back to a full scan.

transitions.guard: Posting entries stay within MAX_ENTRIES after finish()
transitions.action: begin() keeps entries whose stamp is equal and was not racy, re-reads the rest; finish() drops files that left the walk and compacts ids when dead ones outnumber half the live ones plus 1024; only the plan's candidates and always-scan files are scanned.

transitions.guard: Posting entries exceed MAX_ENTRIES after finish()
transitions.action: The index is reset with disabled = true and find_hits falls back to a full scan.
usable() is false, so find_hits scans every file without counting or updating the index.
